answer: One defense is bonded provenance routing. To relay a peer transaction an agent locks collateral in the kernel and needs co-signatures from three counterparties funded independently. A sybil farm is an island in the funding graph: many identities fed by one upstream wallet, no edges leaving. The kernel scores addresses by inbound stake diversity and decays rewards for links confined to that island. Peers publish an atlas of cross-cluster attestations; payouts clear only on edges spanning two clusters. Faking that diversity costs real capital and history mass registration cannot amortize.
